49294816:
This is by far one of the greatest drift racing games I've ever played. It's got a lot of potential, and I do recommend picking it up if you're interested in drifting and car customization.

Positives:

+ Wide variety of vehicles to select from
+ Great customization system
+ Fun community
+ Good drifting mechanics 

Negatives:

- In-game money is required if you want to unlock new tracks, unless you pay for the Deluxe DLC
- Car configuration can be complex if you're unfamiliar with it
- No tutorials for Multiplayer challenges, and will take time to get better at them

Overall: 9.5/10
